author: @saehisaya
comment:
Growing up my sister and I sold lemonade and cakes. My parents are both business owners and they taught us the basics of business. I became really good at cooking and baking so I expanded it into a volunteering program where I gave away food to the needy people. 

Around that time I was learning marketing/data science and economics at school then applied it as much as I could in my business. I also worked for a company so I saw how everything was applied. 

The best advice I can give is to know the laws of your country, always think about what you could improve, and never make excuses. Excuses will kill your drive and business. 

For kids they should play one of those tycoon games and have experience running a small business like selling water during summer to gain an interest. For teens I would say to play games that use a lot of resource management like Factorio or any RPG strategy game, as well as internships.
